correctness.rationale: Four explicit source-axis rays generate exactly four nonsingular image cones. Sorting their target angles (independently of the sign of a) yields all regular target valences 0,2,4, and deduplicating shared source-axis points yields the specified 1,2,3 boundary counts. When |a|>|c|, elimination yields a globally increasing piecewise-affine scalar inverse. Properness, signed degree and exact sector area are separately derived. Exact-Fraction finite checker passed regular and boundary diagnostic grids; its finite nature does not replace proof.
